title: Custom Search JSON API discontinued on 2027-01-01
summary: The Custom Search JSON API is closed to new customers, and existing customers have until 2027-01-01 to move off it; Google calls that date the service discontinuation. After that, calls to /customsearch/v1 stop working.
migrationNote: Replace calls to www.googleapis.com/customsearch/v1 before 2027-01-01: Google points to Vertex AI Search for searching up to 50 domains, and to its interest form for full-web search. Expect a different request format, response shape and pricing.

provenance.quote: Existing Custom Search JSON API customers have until January 1, 2027 to transition to an alternative solution.
